notes.title: Fixing and General optimization
notes.content: [p][b]GENERAL[/b][/p][list][*][p]Overall environment optimization (we recommend playing with the “Ultra Performance” upscale mode, available in the [i]Video[/i] settings).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several audio files from the soundtrack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision issues across all environments.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]TRAIN[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added more clues in the puzzle section to improve readability and adjusted some interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed door issues in the final part of the section.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]BOOK[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the statue area to make the correct path clearer.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]THEATER[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a collision bug in the final section that allowed players to move into another area earlier than intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Checkpoints are now working properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a door interaction during a chase to make escapes smoother.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]ENDING (No Spoilers)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a scripted event at the beginning of the section.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted lighting intensity near the TV.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: General optimization V2
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would not retain saved progress[/p][/*][*][p]The gramophone in the prologue and the statue in the labyrinth now trigger on first interaction[/p][/*][*][p]Moved a note in the ending to make it more visible[/p][/*][*][p]Added particle effects in the ending to guide the player[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: General optimization
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the achievements for notes and interactions would not register as completed despite collecting everything[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted text positions in the "phone scene" to make it more intuitive[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some translation errors in Spanish[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved certain collision issues in the train environment[/p][/*][*][p]Added sprinting after completing the dialogue on the "Transition Bridge"[/p][/*][*][p]Added a manual interaction with the record player in the house to prevent players from unintentionally triggering a cutscene during exploration[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Resolved some general issues
notes.content: [list][*][p]Adjusted collisions in the book environment to make traversal easier[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an asset in the theater[/p][/*][*][p]General optimization of the theater[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved lighting issues on the train[/p][/*][/list]
